EU Proposes 22nd Russia Sanctions Package Targeting Crypto Platforms and 60 Banks European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen announced on November 23 a proposed 22nd sanctions package against Russia, seeking to extend transaction bans to approximately 60 Russian banks and remove them from the SWIFT system. The proposal also targets cryptocurrency platforms and payment networks in Russia and third countries facilitating sanctions evasion. Von der Leyen said the EU has launched a Crypto Sanctions Task Force to strengthen enforcement. Additional measures include expanded energy restrictions, sanctions targeting Russia's shadow fleet, and a ban on EU citizens holding management positions in Russian companies. The package remains subject to approval. — link

Ethereum Foundation Doubles Protocol Security Team, Warns AI Threats Are More Urgent Than Quantum Computing The Ethereum Foundation, said AI-driven security threats have become more urgent than quantum computing risks, with AI models discovering software vulnerabilities faster than humans can review them. The foundation has doubled its protocol security team and made defenses against AI and quantum threats its top priority. Its plans include replacing elliptic-curve cryptography with hash-based signatures for validators and wallets, alongside new blob commitments. The foundation warned that the overhaul would be harder than Ethereum's 2022 Merge and could delay other long-planned upgrades. — link
